name: Kali Linux Desktop
postCreateCommand: apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y xfce4 xfce4-terminal tigervnc-standalone-server novnc dbus-x11
postStartCommand:
mkdir -p /root/.vnc && printf '#!/bin/sh
startxfce4
' > /root/.vnc/xstartup && chmod +x /root/.vnc/xstartup && (vncserver :1 -localhost yes -SecurityTypes None -geometry 1280x800 -depth 24 || true) && (websockify --web=/usr/share/novnc 0.0.0.0:6080 127.0.0.1:5901 >/tmp/novnc.log 2>&1 &)
